questions.question: The Indian National Science Academy is situated in _________.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**New Delhi.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Indian National Science Academy** (INSA) is located in **New Delhi**, the capital city of India.
 
• INSA is a premier scientific organization in India, established in** 1935** to promote **science and its applications** for the benefit of society.
 
• INSA consists of distinguished **scientists and engineers** from various science and technology fields elected as **Fellows of the Academy**.
 
• INSA conducts various activities such as organizing **scientific meetings, conferences, seminars, and workshops, **and awarding fellowships and medals to recognize outstanding contributions to science.
 
• INSA also advises the government on scientific matters and works towards promoting **science education **and the popularization of science in the country.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Hyderabad** is home to several prestigious scientific institutions such as the** Indian Institute of Chemical Technology, the Centre for Cellular and Molecular Biology**, and the **International Institute of Information Technology.**
 
• **Allahabad** is a historic city in Uttar Pradesh and is home to the** Indian Institute of Information Technology, the Motilal Nehru National Institute of Technology,** and the **Indian Institute of Technology.**
 
• **Bangalore, **also known as Bengaluru, is a hub of scientific research and development in India, with institutions such as the** Indian Institute of Science,** the **Indian Space Research Organization**, and the **National Aerospace Laboratories. **

questions.question: 'The state shall endeavour to secure to all workers a living wage and and a decent standard of life'. Which of the following is correct about the given statement in the context of india?

options.text: It is mentioned in the 43rd Article of the Constitution.
It is mentioned in the 44 th Article of Constitution.
This is a Gandhian principle of Directive Principles of State Policy.
This is a liberal principle of Directive Principles of State Policy.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**It is mentioned in the 43rd Article of the Constitution.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given statement "The state shall endeavor to secure to all workers a living wage and a decent standard of life" is mentioned in the 43rd Article of the Constitution of India.
 
• This statement is a part of the **Directive Principles of State Policy (DPSP),** which are** non-justiciable**, meaning they are not enforceable by law.
 
• DPSPs are guidelines for the government to frame policies and make laws that promote the** welfare of the people** and establish a just society in India.
 
• The principle of **securing a living wage and decent standard of life** for workers is in line with the **socialist principles** of the Indian Constitution.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• "The State shall endeavor to secure the citizen a **Uniform Civil Code** throughout the territory of India," reads** Part IV, Article 44** of the Constitution. 
 
• The Directive Principles of State Policy incorporate the Gandhian principles of promoting** cottage industries** in rural areas and **organizing village panchayats.**

questions.question: Which of the following statements is true regarding the Indian monsoon and the Inter Tropical Convergence Zone (ITCZ)?

options.text: The shift in the position of the ITCZ can influence the monsoon patterns in India.
ITCZ is located in the Indo-Gangetic plains during February.
The ITCZ is a phenomenon that occurs only during winter.
The ITCZ has no impact on the Indian monsoon.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**The shift in the position of the ITCZ can influence the monsoon patterns in India.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The (ITCZ) is a belt of low pressure near the equator where trade winds from the **Northern and Southern** Hemispheres come together.
 
• The shift in the position of the ITCZ can influence the **monsoon patterns** in India because it determines the location of the monsoon trough, which is a region of** low pressure** that attracts moisture from the surrounding areas.
 
• During summer, the ITCZ shifts northward towards the** Himalayas**, bringing moisture-laden winds from the **Arabian Sea and Bay of Bengal **to India, resulting in the monsoon season.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• ITCZ is typically located over the** southern Indian Ocean** during this time.
 
• ITCZ is present **throughout the year,** but its position shifts with the seasons.
 
• ITCZ has a significant impact on the** Indian monsoon.**
 
• The** monsoon** is the buildup of **moist clouds **when moisture is released from the atmosphere as it cools down in the form of precipitation.
 
• The ITCZ is the region of the earth where **air convergence** is primarily observed throughout the year.

questions.question: Which country first introduced zero-based budgeting?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**The US.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **US **first introduced **zero-based budgeting** in the **1960s.**
 
• In the 1960s, ZBB was formally initiated in the **Department of Agriculture of the USA** and turned out to be more popular in the 1970s.
 
• The Zero-Based Budgeting applicable today was developed at Texas Instruments Inc. in 1969 by Peter Pyhrr.
 
• Zero-based budgeting is a** budgeting method** in which all expenses must be justified for each new period.
 
• It starts from a** "zero base"** and every function within an organization is analyzed for its** needs and costs.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• India did adopt zero-based budgeting in **1987,** but it was not the first country to do so.
 
• Germany and the UK have also implemented zero-based budgeting, but again, they were **not the first countries** to introduce this method.
 
• Zero-based budgeting is often used by** businesses and governments **to identify areas of inefficiency and to reduce unnecessary expenses.
 
• There are two techniques for tracking expenses: **zero-based budgeting and traditional budgeting.**
 
• Zero-based budgeting aids managers in addressing a company's** lowest costs.**

questions.question: The famous Rath Yatra, Car Festival is associated with which Lord?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is__** Lord Jagannath.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The** Rath Yatra or Car Festival** is a famous festival celebrated in** Puri, Odisha**, and is associated with **Lord Jagannath.** 
 
• The festival involves the procession of Lord Jagannath, along with his siblings,** Lord Balabhadra** and **Goddess Subhadra,** in chariots or raths.
 
• The chariots are pulled by** devotees, **and the procession moves from the Jagannath temple to the **Gundicha temple,** where the deities stay for nine days before returning to the Jagannath temple.
 
• The Rath Yatra is an important festival for devotees of Lord Jagannath, and it is believed that **pulling the chariots** during the festival is a way to attain **moksha or liberation.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Lord Shiva **is worshipped in** Puri**.

 
 
• There is a famous temple dedicated to him called the** Lokanath temple.**
 
 
 
• **Lord Indra** is considered the **god of rain and thunder.**
 
 
• He is one of the **major deities** in Hinduism.
 
 
 
• **Lord Brahma** is considered the** creator of the universe** in Hinduism.
 
 
• He is one of the **Trimurti, **along with Lord Vishnu and Lord Shiva.

questions.question: Which of the following is the main advantage of the import substitution policy?

options.text: It may make the indigenous industries more competitive.
It will help the consumers by providing them with unlimited choices.
It helps the nation achieve self-reliance.
It led to optimum allocation of resources.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**it helps the nation achieve self-reliance.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__ Key Points__**

__
 
• **Import substitution policy** aims to promote **domestic industries** by **reducing imports** and **increasing domestic production.**
 
• This, in turn, helps the nation achieve **self-reliance** and** reduces dependence** on foreign countries for essential goods and services.
 
• By promoting domestic industries, the policy can create** job opportunities** and **boost the economy.**
 
• Import substitution policy may also lead to the development of **new technologies and industries**, which can further strengthen the nation's economy and reduce the need for imports.
 
• However, the policy may also have some drawbacks, such as the** risk of protectionism, increased costs of production,** and **reduced competition.**
 
• Hence, it needs to be** implemented carefully** and in a balanced way.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• "it may make the indigenous industries more competitive", is **partially correct**.

 
 
• By reducing imports, the domestic industries may face **less competition**, which may help them become more competitive.
 
• However, it may also lead to **complacency and reduced innovation.**
 
 
 
• "it will help the consumers by providing them with unlimited choices", is** incorrect.**
 
 
• Import substitution policy aims to** reduce imports, **which may lead to reduced choices for consumers.
 
• However, it may also lead to the development of** domestic alternatives,** which may provide new choices in the long run.
 
 
 
• "it led to optimum allocation of resources, is **incorrect**.
 
 
• Import substitution policy aims to promote **domestic industries,** which may not always lead to the optimum allocation of resources.
 
• It may lead to the development of** inefficient industries or overproduction **of certain goods.

questions.question: What is the most stable mineral during the process of weathering?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Quartz.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__ Key Points__**

__
 
• Quartz is the most stable mineral during the** process of weathering **because it is highly resistant to chemical and physical weathering.
 
• Quartz is a mineral composed of silicon and oxygen atoms in a continuous framework of** SiO₄ silicon-oxygen tetrahedra**.
 
• It is one of the most abundant minerals in the Earth's crust.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Olivine** is a mineral that is typically found in **mafic and ultramafic igneous rocks**.

 
 
• It is** not as stable** as quartz during the process of weathering and can easily break down into clay minerals.
 
 
 
• **Pyroxene** is a group of minerals that are typically found in **mafic and ultramafic igneous rocks.** 
 
 
• Additionally, they arise in the context of** touch and regional metamorphism.**
 
 
 
• **Amphibole** is a group of minerals that are typically found in **mafic and ultramafic igneous rocks.** 
 
 
• Amphibole is a class of inosilicate minerals that **crystallize as prisms **or needle-like structures.
 
• They are made of double-chain **SiO₄ tetrahedra **that are joined at the vertices and typically have** iron or magnesium ions** within their structures.

questions.question:
Which of the following statements is/are correct with respect to income or output?

1. Income or output are flows.

2. Income or output are stocks.

3. Income or output can be defined over a period.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Only 1 and 3.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• ** **__Income or output are **flows **because they represent the amount of money or goods that are generated or produced within a** specific time period. **
 
• Both income and output can be defined over a period, such as a **month, quarter, or year**, which allows for comparisons and analysis over time.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

• **Output **refers to the goods and services produced by **businesses, **which can be measured in terms of **quantity or value.**

questions.question: Which of these expressions is correct?

options.text: If the factor income from abroad is greater than the factor income paid abroad, then GNP would be greater than GDP.
If the factor income from abroad is greater than the factor income paid abroad, then GNP would be lower than GDP.
If the factor income earned from abroad is less than the factor income paid abroad, then GNP would be greater than GDP.
If the net factor income from abroad is negative, then GNP would be greater than GDP.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**If the factor income from abroad is greater than the factor income paid abroad, then GNP would be greater than GDP.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **GNP (Gross National Product)** includes the total value of **goods and services** produced by a country's residents, both **domestically and abroad,** while** GDP (Gross Domestic Product) **only includes the total value of goods and services produced within a country's borders.
 
• The **factor income from abroad** refers to the income earned by a country's residents from investments or work done abroad, while the **factor income paid abroad **refers to the income paid to foreign residents for investments or work done within the country.
 
• If the factor income from abroad is** greater **than the factor income paid abroad, it means that the country's residents are** earning more **from their investments or work abroad than they are paying to foreign residents for their investments or work within the country.
 
• This would result in a** higher GNP than GDP**, as the country's overall income would be higher due to the additional income earned abroad.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• If the factor income earned from abroad is** less** than the factor income paid abroad, it would result in a** lower GNP than GDP, **not a higher one.
 
• **Negative net factor income** from abroad would mean that the country is paying more to** foreign residents** for their investments or work within the country than it is earning from its residents' investments or work abroad.
 
• However, it does not necessarily mean that **GNP would be greater than GDP **as it depends on other factors such as the country's exports and imports.

questions.question: Unit of frequency is ______.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is__** hertz.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__ Key Points__**

__
 
• **Hertz** is the** unit of frequency**, which measures the** number of cycles per second** in a wave or signal.
 
• It is named after** Heinrich Hertz,** a German physicist who first demonstrated the existence of **electromagnetic waves** in the late 19th century
 
• The symbol for **hertz is Hz **and it is commonly used in fields such as physics, electronics, telecommunications, and music.
 
• Other units of frequency include** kilohertz (kHz), megahertz (MHz), and gigahertz (GHz)**, which represent **thousands, millions, and billions of hertz** respectively.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Seconds **(sec) is a unit of **time**.

 
 
• **9,192,631,770** (or 9.192631770 x 10⁹ in decimal notation) cycles of radiation resulting from the** cesium-133 atom** switching between two levels is equal to one second.
 
 
 
• **Grams** (gm) and **centimeters** (cm) are units of **mass and length** respectively.
 
 
• According to the International System of Units, **one-thousandth of a kilogram** is equivalent to one gram, a unit of mass.
 
• **Inches** are larger than centimeters; **2.54 cm **are equal to one inch.
 
• One meter is made up of **100 centimeters**, and each centimeter is made up of **10 millimeters**.

questions.question: Hariprasad Chaurasia plays which of the following musical instruments?

The correct answer is __**Flute.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__ Key Points__**

__
 
• **Hariprasad Chaurasia** plays the** flute,** which is a wind instrument.
 
• The flute is a popular musical instrument in** Indian classical music.**
 
• The sound in the flute is produced by **blowing air across **the edge of the mouthpiece.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

questions.question: Heating ethanol with excess concentrated sulphuric acid produces:
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**ethene.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Ethene** is produced when **ethanol **is heated with excess **concentrated sulphuric acid**, which acts as a **dehydrating agent.**
 
• The reaction takes place through an** elimination process**, where a molecule of water is removed from the **ethanol molecule, **resulting in the formation of ethene.
 
• When pure, the gas has a little **"sweet and musky"** smell and is **combustible.**
 
• It is **colorless.**
 
• The **simplest alkene** is this one. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Ethanol **is a primary alcohol with the molecular formula C₂H₅OH, commonly used as a **fuel, solvent, and disinfectant.**
 
• **Concentrated sulphuric acid** is a strong acid with the molecular formula H₂SO₄, commonly used in the chemical industry as a **dehydrating agent,** **catalyst, and electrolyte.**
 
• **Ethyne** (acetylene) is a** two-carbon alkyne **with the molecular formula C₂H₂, commonly used in the** welding and cutting industry** as a fuel gas.
 
• **Butane** is a** four-carbon alkane **with the molecular formula C₄H₁₀, commonly used as a** fuel gas in lighters, stoves, and heaters.**
 
• **Ethane** is a **two-carbon alkane** with the molecular formula C₂H₆, commonly used as a **fuel gas and refrigerant.**

questions.question: Liberty, Equality and Fraternity slogan of ________ finds an echo in the Preamble of Indian Constitution.
questions.solution:

• The slogan was coined during the French Revolution to represent the aspirations of the people towards** freedom, equality, and brotherhood.**
 
• The French Revolution was a period of political and **social upheaval in France**, which led to the overthrow of the monarchy and the establishment of a republic.

questions.question: Which of the following dance forms originating in Kerala, is a solo recital by women?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Mohiniyattam.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Mohiniyattam** is a classical dance form originating in **Kerala, India, **and is a** solo recital **by women.
 
• It is characterized by **graceful movements, **subtle expressions, and** intricate footwork.**
 
• The term Mohiniyattam is derived from the words **Mohini (meaning enchantress)** and** Attam (meaning dance).**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Odissi** is a dance form that incorporates sculptural poses, intricate footwork, and facial expressions to convey **emotions and stories.**

 
 
• **​'Odhra Magadha'** is the oldest form of modern Odissi dance, according to Natya Shastra. 
 
• It originated in **Odessa.**
 
 
 
• **Kathakali** is a highly stylized form of** dance-drama** that combines dance, music, and acting to depict stories from Indian epics.
 
 
• The origins of Kathakali can be traced to **Kerala** and other parts of southwest India.
 
• A **devotional dance,** kathakali is similar to **Bharatanatyam.**
 
 
 
• **Kuchipudi** is a dance-drama form that involves fast footwork, quicksilver movements, and graceful expressions.
 
 
• It comes from Kuchipudi, a village in the Indian state of **Andhra Pradesh.**
